intentions: Manage inventory categories with CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) and support for unique names, descriptions, and optional reorder thresholds.
Manage products with CRUD operations, foreign key relationships to categories, and validation for uniqueness of SKUs and existence of categories.
Retrieve product data by category, low-stock products, or aggregate stock values by category for reporting purposes.
Provide a command-line interface (CLI) for inventory management with nested command groups for products and categories, including validation and error handling for missing or invalid inputs.
Handle business logic for inventory operations such as adding, updating, deleting, and restocking products, generating low-stock reports, and calculating stock values by category.
